name: End-to-End Reconstruction Model Architecture
aliases: End-to-End Reconstruction Model Architecture — Simultaneous Reconstruction and Denoising Model
definition: An end-to-end deep learning architecture for simultaneous tomographic reconstruction and denoising, consisting of two U-net instances ($g_1$ and $g_2$).
summary: This end-to-end differentiable architecture directly maps noisy sinograms to denoised 3D volumes, replacing fixed filtration with trainable networks to mitigate noise amplification.
